Name: Segment to Segment Relative Accuracy
Description: This TRE contains the DPPDB segment to segment relative accuracy. It is a user-defined file found in the DPPDB data extension subheader.

SISEGID.Name: Segment Model ID
SISEGID.Description: This field indicates the model ID of the DPPDB segment.

SNACE.Name: Segment Absolute CE90
SNACE.Description: This field indicates the absolute CE value of the DPPDB segment with 90% confidence.

SNALE.Name: Segment Absolute LE90
SNALE.Description: This field indicates the absolute LE value of the DPPDB segment with 90% confidence.

SNMCE.Name: Segment Mensuration CE90
SNMCE.Description: This field indicates the mensuration (1 pixel) CE value of the DPPDB segment with 90% confidence.

SNMLE.Name: Segment Mensuration LE90
SNMLE.Description: This field indicates the mensuration (1 pixel) LE value of the DPPDB segment with 90% confidence.

EXACERF.Name: Exceeds Absolute CE Requirement
EXACERF.Description: This field indicates whether the DPPDB product exceeds the absolute CE accuracy requirement. Y means the accuracy of this DPPDB data exceeds the accuracy requirement for its intended use.

EXALERF.Name: Exceeds Absolute LE Requirement
EXALERF.Description: This field indicates whether the DPPDB product exceeds the absolute LE accuracy requirement. Y means the accuracy of this DPPDB data exceeds the accuracy requirement for its intended use.

NBRSEG.Name: Number of Remaining Segments Relative Accuracy
NBRSEG.Description: This field indicates the number of remaining segments relative accuracy.

RASEGID<NBRSEG>.Name: Stereo Image Segment ID
RASEGID<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the ID of the stereo segment.

SNRCE0_1<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative CEP
SNRCE0_1<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative CEP (0-1 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRLE0_1<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative LEP
SNRLE0_1<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative LEP (0-1 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRCE1_5<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative CEP
SNRCE1_5<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative CEP (1-5 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRLE1_5<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative LEP
SNRLE1_5<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative LEP (1-5 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRCE5_15<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative CEP
SNRCE5_15<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative CEP (5-15 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRLE5_15<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative LEP

SNRCE15_30<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative CEP

SNRLE15_30<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative LEP

SNRCE30<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative CEP
SNRCE30<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative CEP (>30 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.

SNRLE30<NBRSEG>.Name: Segment Relative LEP
SNRLE30<NBRSEG>.Description: This field indicates the relative LEP (>30 nm) of the DPPDB stereo segment with 50% confidence.
